title: Culture: How Everyday Norms Shape the Work
before: Every team has habits nobody wrote down.

turns.text: Every team has habits that nobody wrote down. Some of them protect the people we serve. Some of them just make the work harder. In this course, you'll learn to notice the difference, and to respond to mistakes in a way that keeps people willing to speak up.

guidance.text: Standards and perfectionism can look alike from the outside. The test is what happens after a mistake: does the team learn, or does someone hide?
Think of the last mistake on your team. Was the conversation about the person or the process?
None of this lowers the bar. It changes how the team reaches it.
